$Comment: Cut down the Headless Horseman's flying head ten times during one season. KILL_ENTITY names the
Head's own role, Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head, which only his fight raises, and counts for the player
who lands the killing blow; a head that flies back to him unharmed counts for nobody. The
description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount.
Each year's copy pays favor with the Hallowed and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row in Claim, to collect
on the achievements page; the row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on
a server without that mod. It carries no hallowed tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it.
